do_if.value: not $station.isoperational or $station.isplayerowned or (this.ship.order.$scanleaks? and not this.ship.order.$scanleaks)

$leak.exists and $leak.container == $station and not $leak.islocked and ($leak.type == signalleaktype.data or $leak.type == signalleaktype.voice) and not @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$leak}.$vgo_leak_scanned
not $eligible.count and ($station.sector != player.sector or $station.attention lt attention.visible) and not (@player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$station}.$vgo_network_next gt player.age)
